summary: community.general 13 removed atomic_*, catapult, cloud and database utils, cpanm compatibility mode, dimensiondata content, Django runner deprecated params, and the hiera lookup.
questions: Was the hiera lookup removed from community.general?
Which Django runner parameters were removed?

answer_card.title: community.general 13 removals (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed in community.general 13:

- `atomic_container`, `atomic_host`, `atomic_image`, `catapult`
- `cloud` and `database` module utils
- `cpanm`: `mode=compatibility` (migrate to `mode=new`)
- `dimensiondata` doc fragments, module utils, `dimensiondata_network`, `dimensiondata_vlan`
- Django module utils: `database`, `noinput`, `dry_run`, `check` runner parameters
- `hiera` lookup
